# Arguments: zin_arg_act (keyword white_peace 1, belonton_leaves 2).
zin_goldoroth_diplomacy = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_act = 1 }
			has_war_with = Y1A
		}
		Y1A = { white_peace = { tag = ROOT } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_act = 2 } }
		Y19 = { remove_from_faction = ROOT }
		if = {
			limit = { has_war_with = Y1A }
			Y1A = { white_peace = { tag = ROOT } }
		}
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_who (country), zin_arg_modifier (1-based position in the opinion_modifiers block), zin_arg_both (1 for both ways).
zin_goldoroth_opinion = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 1 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_goldoroth_opinion_oath_kept
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_goldoroth_opinion_oath_kept
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 2 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_goldoroth_opinion_troll_silver
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_goldoroth_opinion_troll_silver
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 3 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_goldoroth_opinion_free_dark
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_goldoroth_opinion_free_dark
			}
		}
	}
}
